policies.title: A count can never glue itself to its noun
policies.summary: a multi-line JSX text run that opens with a space and holds an HTML entity, which Next 16's SWC renders as "24marketing".

policies.title: Marketing CSS stays contained
policies.summary: a declaration in marketing.css that leaks app-wide once any marketing route has loaded.

policies.title: The marketing h1 never moves
policies.summary: a reveal-hidden or animated state on a marketing h1, which delays the page's largest paint.

policies.title: Two Tailwind entries, one theme
policies.summary: a lab-only utility reaching the production stylesheet, or a second copy of the theme tokens.

policies.title: The grounds keep their mechanism
policies.summary: a refactor that drops one of the three facts behind the mixed-theme chapters, which fails silently in the browser.

policies.title: Keyframe names are unique
policies.summary: a second @keyframes of the same name in any stylesheet, which shadows the first for the rest of the session.

policies.title: Two faces, and only two
policies.summary: a third typeface: a font-mono class, a --font-mono token, or a mono loader anywhere in src.

policies.title: The vendored beam stays vendored
policies.summary: a drifted copy of the vendored border-beam, or an import that reaches around it.

policies.title: The spill engine keeps its shape
policies.summary: a change to the lamp engine that renders as a hard-edged rectangle instead of light, with nothing else failing.

policies.title: A lamp is placed where light can fall
policies.summary: a lamp mounted where its spill has nothing to land on, which shipped twice and was reverted twice.

policies.title: One manifest gates the marketing media
policies.summary: an asset in public/marketing with no manifest entry, or an entry pointing at a file that is not there.

policies.title: MDX prose obeys the copy rules
policies.summary: an em-dash or a broken internal link in the MDX reading surfaces, which the TypeScript AST guard cannot see.

policies.title: No em-dashes in user-facing copy
policies.summary: an em-dash inside any string, template literal or JSX text under app, components or lib; comments and internal docs are exempt.

policies.title: One name, one module
policies.summary: the same UPPER_SNAKE constant exported from two modules under src/lib, which two green branches can each introduce.

policies.title: Every track claims its lane
policies.summary: a malformed track manifest, or two live tracks claiming the same path prefix.
